SELECT (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(received_cent),0) FROM bill WHERE bill_type='CARD' AND status='SETTLED' AND business_date = #{date}) AS cardIncome, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(i.amount_cent),0) FROM bill_item i JOIN bill b ON b.id=i.bill_id WHERE b.bill_type='SALE' AND b.status='SETTLED' AND b.business_date = #{date} AND i.item_type='PRODUCT' AND i.paid_by_card=0) AS productIncome,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(i.amount_cent),0) FROM bill_item i JOIN bill b ON b.id=i.bill_id WHERE b.bill_type='SALE' AND b.status='SETTLED' AND b.business_date = #{date} AND i.item_type IN ('SERVICE','BOARDING') AND i.paid_by_card=0) AS serviceIncome, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bill WHERE bill_type='SALE' AND status='SETTLED' AND business_date = #{date}) AS billCount,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(l.qty),0) FROM card_consume_log l JOIN bill b ON b.id = l.bill_id WHERE b.business_date = #{date} AND b.status = 'SETTLED') AS consumeTimes

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bill WHERE bill_type='SALE' AND status='SETTLED' AND business_date = #{today}) AS billCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(i.amount_cent),0) FROM bill_item i JOIN bill b ON b.id=i.bill_id WHERE b.bill_type='SALE' AND b.status='SETTLED' AND b.business_date = #{today} AND i.paid_by_card=0) AS todayIncome, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(received_cent),0) FROM bill WHERE bill_type='CARD' AND status='SETTLED' AND business_date = #{today}) AS cardIncome, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_event e JOIN pet p ON p.id = e.pet_id WHERE e.contact_status IS NULL AND p.is_active = 1 AND e.next_due_on IS NOT NULL AND e.next_due_on <= date(#{today}, '+30 day')) AS remindCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE expire_on IS NOT NULL AND expire_on >= #{today} AND expire_on <= date(#{today}, '+30 day')) AS expiringCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE is_active = 1 AND ((safety_qty > 0 AND stock_qty <= safety_qty) OR (safety_qty = 0 AND stock_qty <= IFNULL( (SELECT CAST(v AS INTEGER) FROM store_config WHERE k='low_stock_warn'), 3)))) AS lowStockCount
